comeAcross: Calm operator: measured, direct, no hype. Intellectual clarity with understated confidence; short declaratives, one idea per sentence; data-backed claims only.
offLimits: Never a number without a named source; Karos track-record claims only from the published set (100M+ impressions/month, 2M+ followers managed, $50M+ in sales, 10+ years, 8+ agents). Always "Karos Labs", never bare "Karos". No client names or client financials. Every autonomy claim pairs with the approval-queue line ("everything waits in a queue for your sign-off"). No em dashes, exclamation marks, emoji, or hype words (leverage, synergy, unlock, supercharge, holistic).
